name: Worldforged items without a ladder, or skipping item level 60, climb the full upgrade ladder (#6677)
contract: The Worldforged upgrade ladder is base -> item level 60 (always open) -> 64 (Hakkar) -> 70 -> 73 -> 77 -> 81 -> 88.
Highlands Kitchen Knife 650038 (item level 30) had no recipe at all: its variants carry no base item in ItemAddon.dbc.
It now upgrades into its item level 60 variant 1389941 (store key 4389941, always open, 14650 Runes of Ascension) and
that variant into the Zul'Gurub variant 1379941 (key 1379941, 21700 runes, open once the account has defeated Hakkar).
Ancient Wavepiercer 415029 (epic, item level 43) went straight to item level 64 1378621 through recipe 524. It now
upgrades into its item level 60 variant 1388349 (key 4388349, 29300 runes) and that variant into 1378621 (key 1378621,
43400 runes, Hakkar). Recipe 524 no longer exists.
